fields.Name: Actions
fields.Description: Executes one or more server-side MJ Actions with parameter normalization, policy enforcement, and action circuit breaking.

fields.Name: Sub-Agent
fields.Description: Delegates work to a child or related sub-agent (sequentially or in parallel) and folds results back into the parent run.

fields.Name: Retry
fields.Description: Re-enters the agent prompt loop with updated context, prior step results, or an expanded compacted message.

fields.Name: Success
fields.Description: Concludes the agent run successfully after payload validation, minimum execution checks, and optional self-check.

fields.Name: Failed
fields.Description: Signals a step or run failure, invoking AgentType fallback recovery or terminating the run.

fields.Name: Chat
fields.Description: Sends a conversational message or feedback request to the user (or parent agent in consult mode).

fields.Name: ForEach
fields.Description: Iterates sequentially or in bounded parallel batches over a collection in payload, running an action or sub-agent per item.

fields.Name: While
fields.Description: Repeatedly executes a loop body while a configured payload/context condition evaluates true.

fields.Name: Skill
fields.Description: Activates an approved AI Skill and injects its instructions, actions, and sub-agent capabilities into the run.

fields.Name: Plan
fields.Description: Presents a structured execution plan for human approval before mutating actions or sub-agents run in Plan Mode.

fields.Name: Tasks
fields.Description: Submits a multi-node durable TaskGraph for orchestrated parallel or asynchronous execution.

fields.Name: Handoff
fields.Description: Transfers ownership of the active conversation turn to a validated target agent and concludes the source run.

fields.Name: ClientTools
fields.Description: Invokes one or more client-side tools hosted in the user's browser or workspace session.

fields.Name: Decision
fields.Description: Evaluates one or more typed System-1 decisions without an intervening LLM turn and returns decision results.
